text: Good evening. Thank you.
ipa: /ɡˈʊd ˈivnɪŋ θˈæŋk jˈu/
vi: Chào buổi tối. Cảm ơn bạn.

text: One year ago, I introduced my father when he declared his candidacy.
ipa: /wˈʌn jˈɪɹ əɡˈoʊ ˈaɪ ˌɪntɹədˈust mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚ wˈɛn hˈi dɪklˈɛɹd hˈɪz kˈændɪdəsi/
vi: Một năm trước, tôi đã giới thiệu cha tôi khi ông tuyên bố tranh cử.

text: In his own way, and through his own sheer force of will,
ipa: /ɪn hˈɪz ˈoʊn wˈeɪ ənd θɹˈu hˈɪz ˈoʊn ʃˈɪɹ fˈɔɹs ˈʌv wˈɪl/
vi: Theo cách riêng của mình, và bằng ý chí sắt đá của riêng mình,

text: he sacrificed greatly to enter the political arena as an outsider.
ipa: /hˈi sˈækɹəfˌaɪst ɡɹˈeɪtli tˈu ˈɛntɚ ðə pəlˈɪtəkəl ɚˈinə ˈæz ˈæn aʊtsˈaɪdɚ/
vi: Ông đã hy sinh rất nhiều để bước vào chính trường với tư cách là người ngoài cuộc.

text: And he prevailed against a field of 16 very talented competitors.
ipa: /ənd hˈi pɹɪvˈeɪld əɡˈɛnst ə fˈild ˈʌv 16 vˈɛɹi tˈæləntɪd kəmpˈɛtətɚz/
vi: Và anh ấy đã chiến thắng trước 16 đối thủ rất tài năng.

text: For more than a year, Donald Trump has been the people’s champion,
ipa: /fˈɔɹ mˈɔɹ ðˈæn ə jˈɪɹ dˈɑnəld tɹˈʌmp hˈæz bˈɪn ðə pˈipəlz tʃˈæmpiən/
vi: Trong hơn một năm, Donald Trump đã là nhà vô địch của nhân dân,

text: and tonight he’s the people’s nominee.
ipa: /ənd tənˈaɪt hes ðə pˈipəlz nˌɑmənˈi/
vi: và đêm nay ông ấy là ứng cử viên của nhân dân.

text: Like many of my fellow millenials, I do not consider myself categorically Republican or Democrat.
ipa: /lˈaɪk mˈɛni ˈʌv mˈaɪ fˈɛloʊ millenials ˈaɪ dˈu nˈɑt kənsˈɪdɚ mˌaɪsˈɛlf kˌætəɡˈɑɹɪkli ɹɪpˈʌblɪkən ˈɔɹ dˈɛməkɹˌæt/
vi: Giống như nhiều người thuộc thế hệ thiên niên kỷ của tôi, tôi không coi mình là người theo Đảng Cộng hòa hay Đảng Dân chủ một cách rõ ràng.

text: More than party affiliation, I vote on based
ipa: /mˈɔɹ ðˈæn pˈɑɹti əfˌɪliˈeɪʃən ˈaɪ vˈoʊt ˈɑn bˈeɪst/
vi: Hơn cả đảng phái, tôi bỏ phiếu dựa trên

text: on what I believe is right, for my family and for my country.
ipa: /ˈɑn wˈʌt ˈaɪ bɪlˈiv ˈɪz ɹˈaɪt fˈɔɹ mˈaɪ fˈæməli ənd fˈɔɹ mˈaɪ kˈʌntɹi/

text: Sometimes it’s a tough choice.
ipa: /səmtˈaɪmz ˈɪts ə tˈʌf tʃˈɔɪs/

text: That is not the case this time.
ipa: /ðˈæt ˈɪz nˈɑt ðə kˈeɪs ðˈɪs tˈaɪm/

text: As the proud daughter of your nominee, I am here
ipa: /ˈæz ðə pɹˈaʊd dˈɔtɚ ˈʌv jˈɔɹ nˌɑmənˈi ˈaɪ ˈæm hˈiɹ/

text: to tell you that this is the moment
ipa: /tˈu tˈɛl jˈu ðˈæt ðˈɪs ˈɪz ðə mˈoʊmənt/

text: and Donald Trump is the person to make America great again.
ipa: /ənd dˈɑnəld tɹˈʌmp ˈɪz ðə pˈɝsən tˈu mˈeɪk əmˈɛɹəkə ɡɹˈeɪt əɡˈɛn/

text: Real change, the kind we have not seen in decades is only going to come
ipa: /ɹˈil tʃˈeɪndʒ ðə kˈaɪnd wˈi hˈæv nˈɑt sˈin ɪn dɛkˈeɪdz ˈɪz ˈoʊnli ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu kˈʌm/

text: from outside the system.
ipa: /fɹˈʌm ˈaʊtsˈaɪd ðə sˈɪstəm/

text: And it’s only going to come from a man who’s spent his entire life doing
ipa: /ənd ˈɪts ˈoʊnli ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu kˈʌm fɹˈʌm ə mˈæn whos spˈɛnt hˈɪz ɪntˈaɪɚ lˈaɪf dˈuɪŋ/

text: what others said could not be done.
ipa: /wˈʌt ˈʌðɚz sˈɛd kˈʊd nˈɑt bˈi dˈʌn/

text: My father is a fighter.
ipa: /mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚ ˈɪz ə fˈaɪtɚ/

text: When the primaries got tough and they were tough, he did what any great leader does.
ipa: /wˈɛn ðə pɹˈaɪmˌɛɹiz ɡˈɑt tˈʌf ənd ðˈeɪ wˈɝ tˈʌf hˈi dˈɪd wˈʌt ˈɛni ɡɹˈeɪt lˈidɚ dˈʌz/

text: He dug deeper, worked harder, got better and became stronger.
ipa: /hˈi dˈʌɡ dˈipɚ wˈɝkt hˈɑɹdɚ ɡˈɑt bˈɛtɚ ənd bɪkˈeɪm stɹˈɔŋɚ/

text: I have seen him fight for his family.
ipa: /ˈaɪ hˈæv sˈin hˈɪm fˈaɪt fˈɔɹ hˈɪz fˈæməli/

text: I have seen him fight for his employees.
ipa: /ˈaɪ hˈæv sˈin hˈɪm fˈaɪt fˈɔɹ hˈɪz ɛmplˈɔɪiz/

text: I have seen him fight for his company.
ipa: /ˈaɪ hˈæv sˈin hˈɪm fˈaɪt fˈɔɹ hˈɪz kˈʌmpənˌi/

text: And now, I am seeing him fight for our country.
ipa: /ənd nˈaʊ ˈaɪ ˈæm sˈiɪŋ hˈɪm fˈaɪt fˈɔɹ ˈaʊɚ kˈʌntɹi/

text: It’s been the story of his life and more recently the spirit of his campaign.
ipa: /ˈɪts bˈɪn ðə stˈɔɹi ˈʌv hˈɪz lˈaɪf ənd mˈɔɹ ɹˈisəntli ðə spˈɪɹət ˈʌv hˈɪz kæmpˈeɪn/

text: It’s also a prelude to reaching the goal that unites us all.
ipa: /ˈɪts ˈɔlsoʊ ə pɹˈeɪlˌud tˈu ɹˈitʃɪŋ ðə ɡˈoʊl ðˈæt junˈaɪts ˈʌs ˈɔl/

text: When this party and better still this country knows what it is like to win again.
ipa: /wˈɛn ðˈɪs pˈɑɹti ənd bˈɛtɚ stˈɪl ðˈɪs kˈʌntɹi nˈoʊz wˈʌt ˈɪt ˈɪz lˈaɪk tˈu wˈɪn əɡˈɛn/

text: If it’s possible to be famous and yet not really well done,
ipa: /ˈɪf ˈɪts pˈɑsəbəl tˈu bˈi fˈeɪməs ənd jˈɛt nˈɑt ɹˈɪli wˈɛl dˈʌn/

text: that describes the father who raised me.
ipa: /ðˈæt dɪskɹˈaɪbz ðə fˈɑðɚ hˈu ɹˈeɪzd mˈi/

text: In the same office in Trump Tower, where we now work together,
ipa: /ɪn ðə sˈeɪm ˈɔfɪs ɪn tɹˈʌmp tˈaʊɚ wˈɛɹ wˈi nˈaʊ wˈɝk təɡˈɛðɚ/

text: I remember playing on the floor by my father’s desk,
ipa: /ˈaɪ ɹɪmˈɛmbɚ plˈeɪɪŋ ˈɑn ðə flˈɔɹ bˈaɪ mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚz dˈɛsk/

text: constructing miniature buildings with Legos and Erector sets,
ipa: /kənstɹˈʌktɪŋ mˈɪniətʃˌʊɹ bˈɪldɪŋz wˈɪð legos ənd ɪɹˈɛktɚ sˈɛts/

text: while he did the same with concrete steel and glass.
ipa: /wˈaɪl hˈi dˈɪd ðə sˈeɪm wˈɪð kənkɹˈit stˈil ənd ɡlˈæs/

text: My father taught my siblings and me the importance of positive values
ipa: /mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚ tˈɔt mˈaɪ sˈɪblɪŋz ənd mˈi ðə ˌɪmpˈɔɹtəns ˈʌv pˈɑzətɪv vˈæljuz/

text: and a strong ethical compass.
ipa: /ənd ə stɹˈɔŋ ˈɛθɪkəl kˈʌmpəs/

text: He showed us how to be resilient, how to deal with challenges
ipa: /hˈi ʃˈoʊd ˈʌs hˈaʊ tˈu bˈi ɹɪzˈɪljənt hˈaʊ tˈu dˈil wˈɪð tʃˈæləndʒɪz/

text: and how to strive for excellence in all that we do.
ipa: /ənd hˈaʊ tˈu stɹˈaɪv fˈɔɹ ˈɛksələns ɪn ˈɔl ðˈæt wˈi dˈu/

text: He taught us that there’s nothing that we cannot accomplish,
ipa: /hˈi tˈɔt ˈʌs ðˈæt theres nˈʌθɪŋ ðˈæt wˈi kˈænɑt əkˈɑmplɪʃ/

text: if we marry vision and passion with an enduring work ethic.
ipa: /ˈɪf wˈi mˈɛɹi vˈɪʒən ənd pˈæʃən wˈɪð ˈæn ɛndjˈʊɹɪŋ wˈɝk ˈɛθɪk/

text: One of my father’s greatest talents is the ability to see potential in people,
ipa: /wˈʌn ˈʌv mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚz ɡɹˈeɪtəst tˈælənts ˈɪz ðə əbˈɪlətˌi tˈu sˈi pətˈɛnʃəl ɪn pˈipəl/

text: before they see it in themselves.
ipa: /bɪfˈɔɹ ðˈeɪ sˈi ˈɪt ɪn ðɛmsˈɛlvz/

text: It was like that for us to growing up.
ipa: /ˈɪt wˈɑz lˈaɪk ðˈæt fˈɔɹ ˈʌs tˈu ɡɹˈoʊɪŋ ˈʌp/

text: He taught us that potential vanishes into nothing without effort.
ipa: /hˈi tˈɔt ˈʌs ðˈæt pətˈɛnʃəl vˈænɪʃɪz ˈɪntu nˈʌθɪŋ wɪθˈaʊt ˈɛfɚt/

text: And like him, we each had a responsibility to work,
ipa: /ənd lˈaɪk hˈɪm wˈi ˈitʃ hˈæd ə ɹispˌɑnsəbˈɪləti tˈu wˈɝk/

text: not just for ourselves but for the betterment of the world around us.
ipa: /nˈɑt dʒˈʌst fˈɔɹ aʊɚsˈɛlvz bˈʌt fˈɔɹ ðə bˈɛtɚmənt ˈʌv ðə wˈɝld ɚˈaʊnd ˈʌs/

text: Over the years, on too many occasions to count,
ipa: /ˈoʊvɚ ðə jˈɪɹz ˈɑn tˈu mˈɛni əkˈeɪʒənz tˈu kˈaʊnt/

text: I saw my father tear stories out of the newspaper about people whom he had never
ipa: /ˈaɪ sˈɔ mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚ tˈɛɹ stˈɔɹiz ˈaʊt ˈʌv ðə nˈuzpˌeɪpɚ əbˈaʊt pˈipəl hˈum hˈi hˈæd nˈɛvɚ/

text: met, who were facing some injustice or hardship.
ipa: /mˈɛt hˈu wˈɝ fˈeɪsɪŋ sˈʌm ˌɪndʒˈʌstɪs ˈɔɹ hˈɑɹdʃɪp/

text: He’d write a note to his assistant, in a signature black felt tip pen,
ipa: /hed ɹˈaɪt ə nˈoʊt tˈu hˈɪz əsˈɪstənt ɪn ə sˈɪɡnətʃɚ blˈæk fˈɛlt tˈɪp pˈɛn/

text: and request that the person be found and invited to Trump Tower to meet with him.
ipa: /ənd ɹɪkwˈɛst ðˈæt ðə pˈɝsən bˈi fˈaʊnd ənd ˌɪnvˈaɪtəd tˈu tɹˈʌmp tˈaʊɚ tˈu mˈit wˈɪð hˈɪm/

text: He would talk to them
ipa: /hˈi wˈʊd tˈɔk tˈu ðˈɛm/

text: and then draw upon his extensive network to find them a job
ipa: /ənd ðˈɛn dɹˈɔ əpˈɑn hˈɪz ɪkstˈɛnsɪv nˈɛtwˌɝk tˈu fˈaɪnd ðˈɛm ə dʒˈɑb/

text: or get them a break.
ipa: /ˈɔɹ ɡˈɛt ðˈɛm ə bɹˈeɪk/

text: And they would leave his office, as people so often do
ipa: /ənd ðˈeɪ wˈʊd lˈiv hˈɪz ˈɔfɪs ˈæz pˈipəl sˈoʊ ˈɔfən dˈu/

text: after having been with Donald Trump, feeling that life could be great again.
ipa: /ˈæftɚ hˈævɪŋ bˈɪn wˈɪð dˈɑnəld tɹˈʌmp fˈilɪŋ ðˈæt lˈaɪf kˈʊd bˈi ɡɹˈeɪt əɡˈɛn/

text: Throughout my entire life, I have witnessed his empathy and generosity towards other,
ipa: /θɹuˈaʊt mˈaɪ ɪntˈaɪɚ lˈaɪf ˈaɪ hˈæv wˈɪtnəst hˈɪz ˈɛmpəθi ənd dʒˌɛnɚˈɑsəti təwˈɔɹdz ˈʌðɚ/

text: especially those who are suffering.
ipa: /əspˈɛʃli ðˈoʊz hˈu ˈɑɹ sˈʌfɚɪŋ/

text: It is just his way of being in your corner when you’re down.
ipa: /ˈɪt ˈɪz dʒˈʌst hˈɪz wˈeɪ ˈʌv bˈiɪŋ ɪn jˈɔɹ kˈɔɹnɚ wˈɛn youre dˈaʊn/

text: My father not only has the strength and ability necessary to be our next President,
ipa: /mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚ nˈɑt ˈoʊnli hˈæz ðə stɹˈɛŋkθ ənd əbˈɪlətˌi nˈɛsəsˌɛɹi tˈu bˈi ˈaʊɚ nˈɛkst pɹˈɛzədˌɛnt/

text: but also the kindness and compassion that will enable him to be the leader
ipa: /bˈʌt ˈɔlsoʊ ðə kˈaɪndnəs ənd kəmpˈæʃən ðˈæt wˈɪl ɛnˈeɪbəl hˈɪm tˈu bˈi ðə lˈidɚ/

text: that this country needs.
ipa: /ðˈæt ðˈɪs kˈʌntɹi nˈidz/

text: My father has a sense of fairness that touches every conviction he’s hold.
ipa: /mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚ hˈæz ə sˈɛns ˈʌv fˈɛɹnəs ðˈæt tˈʌtʃəz ˈɛvɚi kənvˈɪkʃən hes hˈoʊld/

text: I worked along side of him for now more than a decade now at the Trump
ipa: /ˈaɪ wˈɝkt əlˈɔŋ sˈaɪd ˈʌv hˈɪm fˈɔɹ nˈaʊ mˈɔɹ ðˈæn ə dɛkˈeɪd nˈaʊ ˈæt ðə tɹˈʌmp/

text: Organization and I’ve seen how he operates as a leader.
ipa: /ˌɔɹɡənəzˈeɪʃən ənd ive sˈin hˈaʊ hˈi ˈɑpɚˌeɪts ˈæz ə lˈidɚ/

text: Making important decisions that shape careers and that change lives.
ipa: /mˈeɪkɪŋ ˌɪmpˈɔɹtənt dɪsˈɪʒənz ðˈæt ʃˈeɪp kɚˈɪɹz ənd ðˈæt tʃˈeɪndʒ lˈɪvz/

text: I’ve learned a lot about the world from walking construction jobs by his side.
ipa: /ive lˈɝnd ə lˈɑt əbˈaʊt ðə wˈɝld fɹˈʌm wˈɔkɪŋ kənstɹˈʌkʃən dʒˈɑbz bˈaɪ hˈɪz sˈaɪd/

text: When run properly, construction sites are true meritocracies.
ipa: /wˈɛn ɹˈʌn pɹˈɑpɚli kənstɹˈʌkʃən sˈaɪts ˈɑɹ tɹˈu meritocracies/

text: Competence in the building trades is easy to spot and incompetence is impossible to hide.
ipa: /kˈɑmpətɪns ɪn ðə bˈɪldɪŋ tɹˈeɪdz ˈɪz ˈizi tˈu spˈɑt ənd ˌɪnkˈɑmpətəns ˈɪz ˌɪmpˈɑsəbəl tˈu hˈaɪd/

text: These sites are also incredible melting pots, gathering people from all walks of life
ipa: /ðˈiz sˈaɪts ˈɑɹ ˈɔlsoʊ ˌɪnkɹˈɛdəbəl mˈɛltɪŋ pˈɑts ɡˈæðɚɪŋ pˈipəl fɹˈʌm ˈɔl wˈɔks ˈʌv lˈaɪf/

text: and uniting them to work towards a single mission.
ipa: /ənd junˈaɪtɪŋ ðˈɛm tˈu wˈɝk təwˈɔɹdz ə sˈɪŋɡəl mˈɪʃən/

text: There have always been men of all background and ethnicities on my father’s job sites.
ipa: /ðˈɛɹ hˈæv ˈɔlwˌeɪz bˈɪn mˈɛn ˈʌv ˈɔl bˈækɡɹˌaʊnd ənd ethnicities ˈɑn mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚz dʒˈɑb sˈaɪts/

text: And long before it was common place, you also saw women.
ipa: /ənd lˈɔŋ bɪfˈɔɹ ˈɪt wˈɑz kˈɑmən plˈeɪs jˈu ˈɔlsoʊ sˈɔ wˈɪmən/

text: My father values talent.
ipa: /mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚ vˈæljuz tˈælənt/

text: He recognizes real knowledge and skill when he finds it.
ipa: /hˈi ɹˈɛkəɡnˌaɪzəz ɹˈil nˈɑlədʒ ənd skˈɪl wˈɛn hˈi fˈaɪndz ˈɪt/

text: He is color blind and gender neutral.
ipa: /hˈi ˈɪz kˈʌlɚ blˈaɪnd ənd dʒˈɛndɚ nˈutɹəl/

text: He hires the best person for the job, period.
ipa: /hˈi hˈaɪɚz ðə bˈɛst pˈɝsən fˈɔɹ ðə dʒˈɑb pˈɪɹiəd/

text: Words and promises, no matter visionary they sound will only get you so far.
ipa: /wˈɝdz ənd pɹˈɑməsəz nˈoʊ mˈætɚ vˈɪʒənˌɛɹi ðˈeɪ sˈaʊnd wˈɪl ˈoʊnli ɡˈɛt jˈu sˈoʊ fˈɑɹ/

text: In our business, you’re not a builder,
ipa: /ɪn ˈaʊɚ bˈɪznəs youre nˈɑt ə bˈɪldɚ/

text: unless you’ve got a building to show for it, or in my father’s case, city skylines.
ipa: /ənlˈɛs youve ɡˈɑt ə bˈɪldɪŋ tˈu ʃˈoʊ fˈɔɹ ˈɪt ˈɔɹ ɪn mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚz kˈeɪs sˈɪti skˈaɪlˌaɪnz/

text: Most people strive their entire lives to achieve great success in a single industry.
ipa: /mˈoʊst pˈipəl stɹˈaɪv ðˈɛɹ ɪntˈaɪɚ lˈɪvz tˈu ətʃˈiv ɡɹˈeɪt səksˈɛs ɪn ə sˈɪŋɡəl ˈɪndəstɹi/

text: My father has succeeded in many on the highest level and on a global scale.
ipa: /mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚ hˈæz səksˈidɪd ɪn mˈɛni ˈɑn ðə hˈaɪəst lˈɛvəl ənd ˈɑn ə ɡlˈoʊbəl skˈeɪl/

text: One of the reasons he has thrived as an entrepreneur is because he listens to everyone.
ipa: /wˈʌn ˈʌv ðə ɹˈizənz hˈi hˈæz θɹˈaɪvd ˈæz ˈæn ˌɑntɹəpɹənˈɝ ˈɪz bɪkˈɔz hˈi lˈɪsənz tˈu ˈɛvɹiwˌʌn/

text: Billionaire executives don’t usually ask the people doing the work for their opinion of the work.
ipa: /bˌɪljənˈɛɹ ɪɡzˈɛkjətɪvz dont jˈuʒəwəli ˈæsk ðə pˈipəl dˈuɪŋ ðə wˈɝk fˈɔɹ ðˈɛɹ əpˈɪnjən ˈʌv ðə wˈɝk/

text: My father is an exception.
ipa: /mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚ ˈɪz ˈæn ɪksˈɛpʃən/

text: TRUMP: On every one of his projects, you’ll see him talking to the super,
ipa: /tɹˈʌmp ˈɑn ˈɛvɚi wˈʌn ˈʌv hˈɪz pɹˈɑdʒɛkts youll sˈi hˈɪm tˈɔkɪŋ tˈu ðə sˈupɚ/

text: the painter, the engineers, the electricians, he’ll ask them for their feedback,
ipa: /ðə pˈeɪntɚ ðə ˈɛndʒənˈɪɹz ðə ɪlɛktɹˈɪʃənz hˈɛl ˈæsk ðˈɛm fˈɔɹ ðˈɛɹ fˈidbˌæk/

text: if they think something should be done differently, or could be done better.
ipa: /ˈɪf ðˈeɪ θˈɪŋk sˈʌmθɪŋ ʃˈʊd bˈi dˈʌn dˈɪfɹəntli ˈɔɹ kˈʊd bˈi dˈʌn bˈɛtɚ/

text: When Donald Trump is in charge, all that counts is ability, effort and excellence.
ipa: /wˈɛn dˈɑnəld tɹˈʌmp ˈɪz ɪn tʃˈɑɹdʒ ˈɔl ðˈæt kˈaʊnts ˈɪz əbˈɪlətˌi ˈɛfɚt ənd ˈɛksələns/

text: This has long been the philosophy at the Trump Organization.
ipa: /ðˈɪs hˈæz lˈɔŋ bˈɪn ðə fəlˈɑsəfi ˈæt ðə tɹˈʌmp ˌɔɹɡənəzˈeɪʃən/

text: At my father’s company, there are more female than male executives.
ipa: /ˈæt mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚz kˈʌmpənˌi ðˈɛɹ ˈɑɹ mˈɔɹ fˈimˌeɪl ðˈæn mˈeɪl ɪɡzˈɛkjətɪvz/

text: Women are paid equally for the work that we do
ipa: /wˈɪmən ˈɑɹ pˈeɪd ˈikwəli fˈɔɹ ðə wˈɝk ðˈæt wˈi dˈu/

text: and when a woman becomes a mother, she is supported, not shut out.
ipa: /ənd wˈɛn ə wˈʊmən bɪkˈʌmz ə mˈʌðɚ ʃˈi ˈɪz səpˈɔɹtɪd nˈɑt ʃˈʌt ˈaʊt/

text: Women represent 46 percent of the total U.S.
ipa: /wˈɪmən ɹˌɛpɹɪzˈɛnt 46 pɚsˈɛnt ˈʌv ðə tˈoʊtəl ˈʌs/

text: labor force, and 40 percent of American households have female primary breadwinners.
ipa: /lˈeɪbɚ fˈɔɹs ənd 40 pɚsˈɛnt ˈʌv əmˈɛɹəkən hˈaʊshˌoʊldz hˈæv fˈimˌeɪl pɹˈaɪmˌɛɹi bɹˈɛdwˌɪnɚz/

text: In 2014, women made 83 cents for every dollar made by a man.
ipa: /ɪn 2014 wˈɪmən mˈeɪd 83 sˈɛnts fˈɔɹ ˈɛvɚi dˈɑlɚ mˈeɪd bˈaɪ ə mˈæn/

text: Single women without children earn 94 cents for each dollar earned by a man,
ipa: /sˈɪŋɡəl wˈɪmən wɪθˈaʊt tʃˈɪldɹən ˈɝn 94 sˈɛnts fˈɔɹ ˈitʃ dˈɑlɚ ˈɝnd bˈaɪ ə mˈæn/

text: whereas married mothers made only 77 cents.
ipa: /wɛɹˈæz mˈɛɹid mˈʌðɚz mˈeɪd ˈoʊnli 77 sˈɛnts/

text: As researchers have noted,
ipa: /ˈæz ɹˈisɚtʃɚz hˈæv nˈoʊtəd/

text: gender is no longer the factor creating the greatest wage discrepancy in this country, motherhood is.
ipa: /dʒˈɛndɚ ˈɪz nˈoʊ lˈɔŋɡɚ ðə fˈæktɚ kɹiˈeɪtɪŋ ðə ɡɹˈeɪtəst wˈeɪdʒ dɪskɹˈɛpənsi ɪn ðˈɪs kˈʌntɹi mˈʌðɚhˌʊd ˈɪz/

text: As President, my father will change the labor laws
ipa: /ˈæz pɹˈɛzədˌɛnt mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚ wˈɪl tʃˈeɪndʒ ðə lˈeɪbɚ lˈɔz/

text: that were put into place at a time
ipa: /ðˈæt wˈɝ pˈʊt ˈɪntu plˈeɪs ˈæt ə tˈaɪm/

text: when women were not a significant portion of the workforce.
ipa: /wˈɛn wˈɪmən wˈɝ nˈɑt ə səɡnˈɪfɪkənt pˈɔɹʃən ˈʌv ðə wˈɝkfˌɔɹs/

text: And he will focus on making quality childcare affordable and accessible for all.
ipa: /ənd hˈi wˈɪl fˈoʊkəs ˈɑn mˈeɪkɪŋ kwˈɑləti tʃˈaɪldkˌɛɹ əfˈɔɹdəbəl ənd æksˈɛsəbəl fˈɔɹ ˈɔl/

text: As a mother myself, of three young children, I know
ipa: /ˈæz ə mˈʌðɚ mˌaɪsˈɛlf ˈʌv θɹˈi jˈʌŋ tʃˈɪldɹən ˈaɪ nˈoʊ/

text: how hard it is to work while raising a family.
ipa: /hˈaʊ hˈɑɹd ˈɪt ˈɪz tˈu wˈɝk wˈaɪl ɹˈeɪzɪŋ ə fˈæməli/

text: And I also know that I’m far more fortunate than most.
ipa: /ənd ˈaɪ ˈɔlsoʊ nˈoʊ ðˈæt ˈɪm fˈɑɹ mˈɔɹ fˈɔɹtʃənət ðˈæn mˈoʊst/

text: American families need relief.
ipa: /əmˈɛɹəkən fˈæməliz nˈid ɹɪlˈif/

text: Policies that allow women with children to thrive should not be novelties,
ipa: /pˈɑləsiz ðˈæt əlˈaʊ wˈɪmən wˈɪð tʃˈɪldɹən tˈu θɹˈaɪv ʃˈʊd nˈɑt bˈi nˈɑvəltiz/

text: they should be the norm.
ipa: /ðˈeɪ ʃˈʊd bˈi ðə nˈɔɹm/

text: Politicians talk about wage equality,
ipa: /pˌɑlətˈɪʃənz tˈɔk əbˈaʊt wˈeɪdʒ ɪkwˈɑləti/

text: but my father has made it a practice at his company throughout his entire career.
ipa: /bˈʌt mˈaɪ fˈɑðɚ hˈæz mˈeɪd ˈɪt ə pɹˈæktəs ˈæt hˈɪz kˈʌmpənˌi θɹuˈaʊt hˈɪz ɪntˈaɪɚ kɚˈɪɹ/
